test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a round table facing the centre. Abhay is the immediate neighbor of both Aditi and Amol. Abha is sitting second to the right of Aditi. Abdul is sitting third to the right of Amol. Aashna is sitting second to the left of Abhay. Who is the immediate neighbor of both Aditi and Abha?
solution: **Given:** Six students are seated around a circular table, all facing toward the center. 1) Abha is seated in the second position to the right of Aditi. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88b57bcf255d6f2575834a812e2f5f5d867628c233b3ded6bd3882686fd23994.png] 2) Aditi and Amol both have Abhay as their immediate neighbor.
